title: Expose adopted H25 full callers and original criteria as readable text
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

A source-only Pro review could inspect the public map but could not retrieve the compressed members through its UTF-8 GitHub interface. The new `research/h25-full-caller-readable-inputs/` directory resolves that transport gap with 12 files / 431,107 bytes.

The selected full baseline (102614 bytes, SHA256 `9bbafe3f53febec7a984751b9e06741e06df34e2e6fa7c328c805b9eea700bd7`) and full candidate (104276 bytes, `fa9f473320e9df3a2328bd8388f12eca4e7fc3eeed9289f7fdbf2eeb32a7452f`) remain distinct from the inherited 89606-byte `1e8202b7…` driver. The actual complete CLI and original activity document are also byte-exact. All 49 original completion-test strings in historical v16 match v19; v16's progress/status notes remain historical.

**Source transport only.** No program logic changes and no original activity, stage-gate, overall, runtime, performance or kappa credit. Original progress remains46.00%,24/49,S038/8,stage3/10,overall1/10,24components/52helpers. Full-workload integration and genuine current/native/control/resource qualification remain open.
